Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping.
Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting.
Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.
Require Import ConfigTyping OperationalSemantics TypedOperationalSemantics.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Context (Hms : mode_has_sef typing_mode).

Context (Hmm : mode_has_mutability typing_mode).

Theorem swap_calls_transformation_guarantee ta tb Ta Tb:
  〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ta ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm typing_mode (trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode))∼> 〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ tb ∶ Tb〉 ->
  closed ta ->
  closed tb ->
  closed Ta ->
  closed Tb ->

  exists Ca Cb,
    config_initial ta Ca /\
    config_initial tb Cb /\
    (
      ( exists  na nb Ga2 Gb2 Ca2 Cb2,

        nb <= na /\

        ctx_empty ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta ⊣na↦* Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 /\
        ctx_empty ⊢ Cb ∶ Tb ⊣nb↦* Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 /\
        answer Ca2 /\
        answer Cb2 /\

        〈Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_lift_sim_conf typing_mode (trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode))∼> 〈Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 ∶ Tb〉
      ) \/ (
         forall (n : nat),
         exists (Ca2 Cb2 : config),
           Ca ⊣n↦* Ca2 /\
           Cb ⊣n↦* Cb2
      )
    ).

End WithTypingMode.

## Task

Prove the call-swapping guarantee for roDOT. Cover both related terminating executions where the transformed run uses no more steps and the case where both can run for arbitrarily many steps.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `swap_calls_transformation_guarantee`

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra DotTactics AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Context Equivalence Indep GeneralTyping.

Require Import Weakening.

Unset Auto Template Polymorphism.
Inductive TypedElement (AC AT A: Type): Type := typed_elem (G: AC) (T: AT) (a: A).
Set Auto Template Polymorphism.

Notation "'〈' G '⊢' a '∶' T '〉'" :=
  (typed_elem G T a) (at level 41, G at level 32).

Definition Transform (AC AT A: Type) := (TypedElement AC AT A) -> (TypedElement AC AT A) -> Prop.

Definition transform (AC AT A: Type) (Tr: Transform AC AT A) a b := Tr a b.

Notation " TEa '∼' trf '∼>' TEb " :=
  (transform trf TEa TEb) (at level 42).

Definition TrfCond TC T A := TypedElement TC T A -> Prop.

Definition trf_concat TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
    fun TEa TEb =>
      exists TEc,
      TEa ∼trf1∼> TEc /\
      TEc ∼trf2∼> TEb.

Definition trf_union TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
    fun TEa TEb =>
      TEa ∼trf1∼> TEb \/
      TEa ∼trf2∼> TEb.

Definition trf_inverse TC T A (trf: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
    fun TEa TEb =>
      TEb ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class ReflexiveTransform TC T A (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_reflexive TEa: TEa ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class SymmetricTransform TC T A (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_symmetric TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    TEb ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class TransitiveTransform C T A (trf: Transform C T A) :=
  trf_transitive TEa TEb TEc:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    TEb ∼trf∼> TEc ->
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEc.

Class ReflexiveIfTransform TC T A (Cond: TrfCond TC T A) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_reflexive_if TEa: Cond TEa -> TEa ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class IdempotentTransformOp TC T A (trfop: Transform TC T A -> Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_op_idempotent trf: (trfop trf) = (trfop (trfop trf)).

Class TransformRequires TC T A (Cond: TrfCond TC T A) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_requires TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa.

Class TransformPreserves TC T A (Cond: TrfCond TC T A) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_preserves TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa ->
    Cond TEb.

Class TransformEnsures TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_ensures TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa TEb.

Class TransformClosedOver TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_closer_over TEa TEb TEc:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa TEc ->
    TEc ∼trf∼> TEb.

Class TransformShares TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_shares TEa TEb TEc:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEc ->
    Cond TEb TEc.

Notation TransformFunctional TC T A := (@TransformShares TC T A eq).

Class TransformCommute TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_commute:
    trf_concat trf1 trf2 = trf_concat trf2 trf1.

Class TransformCompat TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_compat TEa1 TEb1 TEa2 TEb2:
    TEa1 ∼trf1∼> TEb1 ->
    TEa1 ∼trf2∼> TEa2 ->
    TEb1 ∼trf2∼> TEb2 ->
    TEa2 ∼trf1∼> TEb2.

Class TransformCondCompat TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_cond_compat TEa1 TEb1 TEa2 TEb2:
    TEa1 ∼trf1∼> TEb1 ->
    TEa1 ∼trf2∼> TEa2 ->
    TEb1 ∼trf2∼> TEb2 ->
    Cond TEa2 TEb2 ->
    TEa2 ∼trf1∼> TEb2.

Inductive trf_iterate TC T A (Cond: _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
| trf_iterate_0 TEa:
  Cond TEa ->
  TEa ∼(trf_iterate Cond trf)∼> TEa
| trf_iterate_S TEa TEb TEc:
  TEa ∼(trf_iterate Cond trf)∼> TEb ->
  TEb ∼trf∼> TEc ->
  TEa ∼(trf_iterate Cond trf)∼> TEc.

Definition trf_id_cond TC T A (Cond: _ -> Prop): Transform TC T A :=
  fun TEa TEb =>
    TEa = TEb /\ Cond TEa.

Definition TransformCondTypeIdentical TC T A (TEa TEb: TypedElement TC T A) :=
  match TEa,TEb with
    〈Ga ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉,〈Gb ⊢ b ∶ Tb〉 => Ga = Gb /\ Ta = Tb
  end.

Notation " TEa '∼' Cond '∼∼' trf '∼>' TEb " :=
  ((Cond TEa TEb) -> (transform trf TEa TEb)) (at level 42, no associativity).

Definition LiftCond := forall TC T A : Type, TypedElement TC T A -> TypedElement TC T A -> Prop.

Definition trf_liftcond_id: LiftCond := fun TC T A => (@eq (TypedElement TC T A)).

Definition trf_liftcond_true: LiftCond := fun TC T A TEa TEb => True.

Definition trf_liftcond_inverse (Cond: LiftCond): LiftCond := fun TC T A TEa TEb => Cond TC T A TEb TEa.

Class TransformLiftCondSymmetric (Cond: LiftCond):=
  trf_liftcond_symmetric TC T A TEa TEb:
    Cond TC T A TEa TEb ->
    Cond TC T A TEb TEa.

Definition ImplyTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf1 TEa TEb ->
  trf2 TEa TEb.

Definition InverseTransformInd (TC1 TC2 T1 T2 A1 A2: Type) (trf: Transform TC1 T1 A1) (trfop: Transform TC1 T1 A1 -> Transform TC2 T2 A2) :=
  ImplyTransformInd (trfop trf) (trf_inverse (trfop (trf_inverse trf))).

Definition InverseTransformIndCond (TC1 TC2 T1 T2 A1 A2: Type) (Cond: LiftCond) (trf: Transform TC1 T1 A1) (trfop: LiftCond -> Transform TC1 T1 A1 -> Transform TC2 T2 A2) :=
  ImplyTransformInd (trfop Cond trf) (trf_inverse (trfop (trf_liftcond_inverse Cond) (trf_inverse trf))).

Definition CondTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (Cond: _ -> Prop) (trf1: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf1 TEa TEb ->
  Cond TEa.

Definition ClosedTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop)  (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf TEa TEb ->
  forall TEc,
  Cond TEa TEc ->
  trf TEc TEb.

Definition CondCompatTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop)  (trf trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf TEa TEb ->
  forall TEc TEd,
  trf2 TEa TEc ->
  trf2 TEb TEd ->
  Cond TEc TEd ->
  trf TEc TEd.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra DotTactics AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Context Equivalence Indep GeneralTyping.

Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting Weakening EWeakening Substitution.

Require Import ConfigTyping TFree TFreeTyping HeapCorrespondence InertContext ConfigTypingAccessories.

Require Import TypedOperationalSemantics OperationalSemantics ConfigVarkinds EnvCorrespondence SealClosed.

Require Import Sealing.

Definition TransformHeap := Transform renv ctx heap.

Definition TransformItem := Transform TrfContextTy var item.

Definition TransformStack := Transform TrfContextTy (typ*typ) stack.

Definition TransformConfig := Transform ctx typ config.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Definition TransformCondConfTyped (TEa: TypedElement ctx typ config) :=
  match TEa with
    〈G ⊢ C ∶ T〉 => ty_config G C T
  end.

Definition TransformCondHeapCorr (TEa: TypedElement renv ctx heap) :=
  match TEa with
    〈e ⊢ Si ∶ G〉 =>
      heap_correspond_accessories G e Si ->
      heap_correspond G e Si
  end.

Definition TransformCondStackTyped (TEa: TypedElement TrfContextTy (typ*typ) stack) :=
  match TEa with
    〈G⁏e ⊢ fs ∶ (Tt, T)〉 => ty_stack G e Tt fs T
  end.

Inductive trf_focus_conf (Cond: LiftCond) (TL: TermTransform): TransformConfig:=
  trf_focus_conf_focus Ga Gb ea eb fs S ta tb Tta Ttb Tsa Tsb Ta Tb Lva Lvb:
    ty_config_accessories Ga ea fs S ta Ta Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories Gb eb fs S tb Tb Lvb ->
    heap_correspond Ga ea S ->
    heap_correspond Gb eb S ->
    ty_stack Ga ea Tsa fs Ta ->
    ty_stack Gb eb Tsb fs Tb ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ ta ∶ Tta〉 ∼TL∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ tb ∶ Ttb〉 ->
    Ga ⁏ ea ⊢ Tta <: Tsa ->
    Gb ⁏ eb ⊢ Ttb <: Tsb ->
    〈Ga ⊢ ta; fs; S; ea; Lva ∶ Ta〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_focus_conf Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb ⊢ tb; fs; S; eb; Lvb ∶ Tb〉.

Inductive trf_focus_idtyp_conf (TL: TermTransform): TransformConfig:=

  trf_focus_idtyp_conf_focus G e fs S ta tb Tt Ts T Lva Lvb:
    ty_config_accessories G e fs S ta T Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories G e fs S tb T Lvb ->
    heap_correspond G e S ->
    ty_stack G e Ts fs T ->
    〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ Tt〉 ∼TL∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ Tt〉 ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ Tt <: Ts ->
    〈G ⊢ ta; fs; S; e; Lva ∶ T〉 ∼(trf_focus_idtyp_conf TL)∼> 〈G ⊢ tb; fs; S; e; Lvb ∶ T〉.

Inductive trf_lift_stack (Cond: LiftCond) (TL: TermTransform): TransformStack :=
| trf_lift_stack_e Ga ea Gb eb fs ta tb T1a T1b T2a T2b T3a T3b L:
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      〈Ga § x / v_let ~ T1a⁏ea ⊢ (open x ta) ∶ T2a〉 ∼(trf_local_trm typing_mode Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb § x / v_let ~ T1b⁏eb ⊢ (open x tb) ∶ T2b〉
    ) ->
    ty_stack Ga ea T2a fs T3a ->
    ty_stack Gb eb T2b fs T3b ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let ta) fs) ∶ (T1a, T3a)〉 ∼(Cond TrfContextTy _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_stack Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let tb) fs) ∶ (T1b, T3b)〉
| trf_lift_stack_n Ga ea Gb eb fsa fsb t T1a T1b T2a T2b T3a T3b L:
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ fsa ∶ (T2a,T3a)〉 ∼(trf_lift_stack Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ fsb ∶ (T2b,T3b)〉 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      Ga § x / v_let ~ T1a ⁏ea ⊢ open x t ∶ T2a
    ) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      Gb § x / v_let ~ T1b ⁏eb ⊢ open x t ∶ T2b
    ) ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let t) fsa) ∶ (T1a,T3a)〉 ∼(Cond TrfContextTy _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_stack Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let t) fsb) ∶ (T1b,T3b)〉.

Inductive trf_lift_idtyp_stack (TL: TermTransform): TransformStack :=
| trf_lift_idtyp_stack_e Ga ea fs ta tb T1a T2a T3a L:
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      〈Ga § x / v_let ~ T1a⁏ea ⊢ (open x ta) ∶ T2a〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm typing_mode TL)∼> 〈Ga § x / v_let ~ T1a⁏ea ⊢ (open x tb) ∶ T2a〉
    ) ->
    ty_stack Ga ea T2a fs T3a ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let ta) fs) ∶ (T1a, T3a)〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_stack TL)∼> 〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let tb) fs) ∶ (T1a, T3a)〉
| trf_lift_idtyp_stack_n Ga ea fsa fsb t T1a T2a T3a L:
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ fsa ∶ (T2a,T3a)〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_stack TL)∼> 〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ fsb ∶ (T2a,T3a)〉 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      Ga § x / v_let ~ T1a ⁏ea ⊢ open x t ∶ T2a
    ) ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let t) fsa) ∶ (T1a,T3a)〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_stack TL)∼> 〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let t) fsb) ∶ (T1a,T3a)〉.

Inductive trf_lift_item (Cond: LiftCond) (TL: TermTransform): TransformItem :=
| trf_lift_item_fun Ga Gb ea eb y ta tb Sa Sb Ta Tb L:
    mode_has_fun' typing_mode = true ->
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun Sa Ta) Ga ->
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun Sb Tb) Gb ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       〈(Ga § x / v_par ~ Sa) ⁏ ea ⊢  (open x ta) ∶ (open x Ta)〉 ∼(trf_local_trm typing_mode Cond TL)∼> 〈(Gb § x / v_par ~ Sb) ⁏ eb ⊢ (open x tb) ∶ (open x Tb)〉
    ) ->
    all_tfree_k Ga ta v_ref ->
    all_tfree_k Gb tb v_ref ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (item_fun ta) ∶ y〉 ∼(Cond TrfContextTy _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_item Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ (item_fun tb) ∶ y〉
| trf_lift_item_obj Ga Gb ea eb y dsa dsb Ua Ub Sa Sb:
    ctx_binds y (typ_objref Ua Sa) Ga ->
    ctx_binds y (typ_objref Ub Sb) Gb ->
    〈Ga§§(objctx_heap y Ua)⁏ea ⊢ dsa ∶ (open y Ua)〉 ∼(trf_local_defs typing_mode Cond TL )∼> 〈Gb§§(objctx_heap y Ub)⁏eb ⊢ dsb ∶ (open y Ub)〉 ->
    defs_varkinds Ga dsa ->
    defs_varkinds Gb dsb ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (item_obj dsa) ∶ y〉 ∼(Cond TrfContextTy _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_item Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ (item_obj dsb) ∶ y〉.

Inductive trf_lift_idtyp_item (TL: TermTransform): TransformItem :=
| trf_lift_idtyp_item_fun G e y ta tb S T L:
    mode_has_fun' typing_mode = true ->
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun S T) G ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       〈(G § x / v_par ~ S) ⁏ e ⊢  (open x ta) ∶ (open x T)〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm typing_mode TL)∼> 〈(G § x / v_par ~ S) ⁏ e ⊢ (open x tb) ∶ (open x T)〉
    ) ->
    all_tfree_k G ta v_ref ->
    all_tfree_k G tb v_ref ->
    〈G⁏e ⊢ (item_fun ta) ∶ y〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_item TL)∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ (item_fun tb) ∶ y〉
| trf_lift_idtyp_item_obj G e y dsa dsb U S:
    ctx_binds y (typ_objref U S) G ->
    〈G§§(objctx_heap y U)⁏e ⊢ dsa ∶ (open y U)〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_defs typing_mode TL )∼> 〈G§§(objctx_heap y U)⁏e ⊢ dsb ∶ (open y U)〉 ->
    defs_varkinds G dsa ->
    defs_varkinds G dsb ->
    〈G⁏e ⊢ (item_obj dsa) ∶ y〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_item TL)∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ (item_obj dsb) ∶ y〉.

Inductive trf_lift_heap (Cond: LiftCond) (TL: TermTransform): TransformHeap :=
| trf_lift_heap_e Ga Gb ea eb ita itb S x:

    (forall y, y \in dom S ->
      ty_item_s typing_mode Ga ea S y
    ) ->
    (forall y, y \in dom S ->
      ty_item_s typing_mode Gb eb S y
    ) ->

    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ ita ∶ x〉 ∼(trf_lift_item Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ itb ∶ x〉 ->
    〈ea ⊢ (S & x ~ ita) ∶ Ga〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈eb ⊢ (S & x ~ itb) ∶ Gb〉
| trf_lift_heap_n Ga Gb ea eb Sa Sb x it:
    〈ea ⊢ Sa ∶ Ga〉 ∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈eb ⊢ Sb ∶ Gb〉 ->
    ty_item_s typing_mode Ga ea (x ~ it) x ->
    ty_item_s typing_mode Gb eb (x ~ it) x ->
    〈ea ⊢ (Sa & x ~ it) ∶ Ga〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈eb ⊢ (Sb & x ~ it) ∶ Gb〉.

Inductive trf_lift_idtyp_heap (TL: TermTransform): TransformHeap :=
| trf_lift_idtyp_heap_e G e ita itb S x:

    (forall y, y \in dom S ->
      ty_item_s typing_mode G e S y
    ) ->

Class TransformConfigReducesTo1(trf1 trf2: TransformConfig) :=

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra DotTactics AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Context Equivalence Indep GeneralTyping.

Require Import Weakening.

Unset Auto Template Polymorphism.
Inductive TypedElement (AC AT A: Type): Type := typed_elem (G: AC) (T: AT) (a: A).
Set Auto Template Polymorphism.

Notation "'〈' G '⊢' a '∶' T '〉'" :=
  (typed_elem G T a) (at level 41, G at level 32).

Definition Transform (AC AT A: Type) := (TypedElement AC AT A) -> (TypedElement AC AT A) -> Prop.

Definition transform (AC AT A: Type) (Tr: Transform AC AT A) a b := Tr a b.

Notation " TEa '∼' trf '∼>' TEb " :=
  (transform trf TEa TEb) (at level 42).

Definition TrfCond TC T A := TypedElement TC T A -> Prop.

Definition trf_concat TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
    fun TEa TEb =>
      exists TEc,
      TEa ∼trf1∼> TEc /\
      TEc ∼trf2∼> TEb.

Definition trf_union TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
    fun TEa TEb =>
      TEa ∼trf1∼> TEb \/
      TEa ∼trf2∼> TEb.

Definition trf_inverse TC T A (trf: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
    fun TEa TEb =>
      TEb ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class ReflexiveTransform TC T A (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_reflexive TEa: TEa ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class SymmetricTransform TC T A (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_symmetric TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    TEb ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class TransitiveTransform C T A (trf: Transform C T A) :=
  trf_transitive TEa TEb TEc:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    TEb ∼trf∼> TEc ->
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEc.

Class ReflexiveIfTransform TC T A (Cond: TrfCond TC T A) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_reflexive_if TEa: Cond TEa -> TEa ∼trf∼> TEa.

Class IdempotentTransformOp TC T A (trfop: Transform TC T A -> Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_op_idempotent trf: (trfop trf) = (trfop (trfop trf)).

Class TransformRequires TC T A (Cond: TrfCond TC T A) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_requires TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa.

Class TransformPreserves TC T A (Cond: TrfCond TC T A) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_preserves TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa ->
    Cond TEb.

Class TransformEnsures TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_ensures TEa TEb:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa TEb.

Class TransformClosedOver TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_closer_over TEa TEb TEc:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    Cond TEa TEc ->
    TEc ∼trf∼> TEb.

Class TransformShares TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_shares TEa TEb TEc:
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEb ->
    TEa ∼trf∼> TEc ->
    Cond TEb TEc.

Notation TransformFunctional TC T A := (@TransformShares TC T A eq).

Class TransformCommute TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_commute:
    trf_concat trf1 trf2 = trf_concat trf2 trf1.

Class TransformCompat TC T A (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_compat TEa1 TEb1 TEa2 TEb2:
    TEa1 ∼trf1∼> TEb1 ->
    TEa1 ∼trf2∼> TEa2 ->
    TEb1 ∼trf2∼> TEb2 ->
    TEa2 ∼trf1∼> TEb2.

Class TransformCondCompat TC T A (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop) (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  trf_cond_compat TEa1 TEb1 TEa2 TEb2:
    TEa1 ∼trf1∼> TEb1 ->
    TEa1 ∼trf2∼> TEa2 ->
    TEb1 ∼trf2∼> TEb2 ->
    Cond TEa2 TEb2 ->
    TEa2 ∼trf1∼> TEb2.

Inductive trf_iterate TC T A (Cond: _ -> Prop) (trf: Transform TC T A): Transform TC T A :=
| trf_iterate_0 TEa:
  Cond TEa ->
  TEa ∼(trf_iterate Cond trf)∼> TEa
| trf_iterate_S TEa TEb TEc:
  TEa ∼(trf_iterate Cond trf)∼> TEb ->
  TEb ∼trf∼> TEc ->
  TEa ∼(trf_iterate Cond trf)∼> TEc.

Definition trf_id_cond TC T A (Cond: _ -> Prop): Transform TC T A :=
  fun TEa TEb =>
    TEa = TEb /\ Cond TEa.

Definition TransformCondTypeIdentical TC T A (TEa TEb: TypedElement TC T A) :=
  match TEa,TEb with
    〈Ga ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉,〈Gb ⊢ b ∶ Tb〉 => Ga = Gb /\ Ta = Tb
  end.

Notation " TEa '∼' Cond '∼∼' trf '∼>' TEb " :=
  ((Cond TEa TEb) -> (transform trf TEa TEb)) (at level 42, no associativity).

Definition LiftCond := forall TC T A : Type, TypedElement TC T A -> TypedElement TC T A -> Prop.

Definition trf_liftcond_id: LiftCond := fun TC T A => (@eq (TypedElement TC T A)).

Definition trf_liftcond_true: LiftCond := fun TC T A TEa TEb => True.

Definition trf_liftcond_inverse (Cond: LiftCond): LiftCond := fun TC T A TEa TEb => Cond TC T A TEb TEa.

Class TransformLiftCondSymmetric (Cond: LiftCond):=
  trf_liftcond_symmetric TC T A TEa TEb:
    Cond TC T A TEa TEb ->
    Cond TC T A TEb TEa.

Definition ImplyTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (trf1 trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf1 TEa TEb ->
  trf2 TEa TEb.

Definition InverseTransformInd (TC1 TC2 T1 T2 A1 A2: Type) (trf: Transform TC1 T1 A1) (trfop: Transform TC1 T1 A1 -> Transform TC2 T2 A2) :=
  ImplyTransformInd (trfop trf) (trf_inverse (trfop (trf_inverse trf))).

Definition InverseTransformIndCond (TC1 TC2 T1 T2 A1 A2: Type) (Cond: LiftCond) (trf: Transform TC1 T1 A1) (trfop: LiftCond -> Transform TC1 T1 A1 -> Transform TC2 T2 A2) :=
  ImplyTransformInd (trfop Cond trf) (trf_inverse (trfop (trf_liftcond_inverse Cond) (trf_inverse trf))).

Definition CondTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (Cond: _ -> Prop) (trf1: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf1 TEa TEb ->
  Cond TEa.

Definition ClosedTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop)  (trf: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf TEa TEb ->
  forall TEc,
  Cond TEa TEc ->
  trf TEc TEb.

Definition CondCompatTransformInd (TC T A: Type) (Cond: _ -> _ -> Prop)  (trf trf2: Transform TC T A) :=
  forall TEa TEb,
  trf TEa TEb ->
  forall TEc TEd,
  trf2 TEa TEc ->
  trf2 TEb TEd ->
  Cond TEc TEd ->
  trf TEc TEd.

Definition TransformCondConfTyped (TEa: TypedElement ctx typ config) :=

Inductive trf_focus_conf (Cond: LiftCond) (TL: TermTransform): TransformConfig:=
  trf_focus_conf_focus Ga Gb ea eb fs S ta tb Tta Ttb Tsa Tsb Ta Tb Lva Lvb:
    ty_config_accessories Ga ea fs S ta Ta Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories Gb eb fs S tb Tb Lvb ->
    heap_correspond Ga ea S ->
    heap_correspond Gb eb S ->
    ty_stack Ga ea Tsa fs Ta ->

| trf_lift_stack_e Ga ea Gb eb fs ta tb T1a T1b T2a T2b T3a T3b L:
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      〈Ga § x / v_let ~ T1a⁏ea ⊢ (open x ta) ∶ T2a〉 ∼(trf_local_trm typing_mode Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb § x / v_let ~ T1b⁏eb ⊢ (open x tb) ∶ T2b〉
    ) ->
    ty_stack Ga ea T2a fs T3a ->
    ty_stack Gb eb T2b fs T3b ->
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let ta) fs) ∶ (T1a, T3a)〉 ∼(Cond TrfContextTy _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_stack Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ (stack_cons (frame_let tb) fs) ∶ (T1b, T3b)〉

    (forall x, x \notin L ->

| trf_lift_item_fun Ga Gb ea eb y ta tb Sa Sb Ta Tb L:
    mode_has_fun' typing_mode = true ->
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun Sa Ta) Ga ->
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun Sb Tb) Gb ->

    ) ->

    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ ita ∶ x〉 ∼(trf_lift_item Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏eb ⊢ itb ∶ x〉 ->
    〈ea ⊢ (S & x ~ ita) ∶ Ga〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈eb ⊢ (S & x ~ itb) ∶ Gb〉
| trf_lift_heap_n Ga Gb ea eb Sa Sb x it:
    〈ea ⊢ Sa ∶ Ga〉 ∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈eb ⊢ Sb ∶ Gb〉 ->
    ty_item_s typing_mode Ga ea (x ~ it) x ->
    ty_item_s typing_mode Gb eb (x ~ it) x ->
    〈ea ⊢ (Sa & x ~ it) ∶ Ga〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈eb ⊢ (Sb & x ~ it) ∶ Gb〉.

Inductive trf_lift_idtyp_heap (TL: TermTransform): TransformHeap :=
| trf_lift_idtyp_heap_e G e ita itb S x:

    (forall y, y \in dom S ->
      ty_item_s typing_mode G e S y
    ) ->

    〈G⁏e ⊢ ita ∶ x〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_item TL)∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ itb ∶ x〉 ->
    〈e ⊢ (S & x ~ ita) ∶ G〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_heap TL)∼> 〈e ⊢ (S & x ~ itb) ∶ G〉
| trf_lift_idtyp_heap_n G e Sa Sb x it:
    〈e ⊢ Sa ∶ G〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_heap TL)∼> 〈e ⊢ Sb ∶ G〉 ->
    ty_item_s typing_mode G e (x ~ it) x ->
    〈e ⊢ (Sa & x ~ it) ∶ G〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_heap TL)∼> 〈e ⊢ (Sb & x ~ it) ∶ G〉.

Inductive trf_lift_conf (Cond: LiftCond) (TL: TermTransform): TransformConfig :=

| trf_lift_conf_focus Ga Gb Ta Tb Ca Cb:
    〈Ga ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_focus_conf Cond (trf_local_trm typing_mode Cond TL))∼> 〈Gb ⊢ Cb ∶ Tb〉 ->
    〈Ga ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_conf Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb ⊢ Cb ∶ Tb〉

| trf_lift_conf_heap Ga Gb e fs Sa Sb t Tta Ttb Ta Tb Lva Lvb:
    ty_config_accessories Ga e fs Sa t Ta Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories Gb e fs Sb t Tb Lvb ->
    heap_correspond_accessories Ga e Sa ->
    heap_correspond_accessories Gb e Sb ->
    〈e ⊢ Sa ∶ Ga〉 ∼(trf_lift_heap Cond TL)∼> 〈e ⊢ Sb ∶ Gb〉 ->
    ty_stack Ga e Tta fs Ta ->
    ty_stack Gb e Ttb fs Tb ->
    Ga⁏e ⊢ t ∶ Tta ->
    Gb⁏e ⊢ t ∶ Ttb ->
    〈Ga ⊢ (t; fs; Sa; e; Lva) ∶ Ta〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_conf Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb ⊢ (t; fs; Sb; e; Lvb) ∶ Tb〉

| trf_lift_conf_stack Ga Gb e fsa fsb S t Tta Ttb Ta Tb Lva Lvb:
    ty_config_accessories Ga e fsa S t Ta Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories Gb e fsb S t Tb Lvb ->
    heap_correspond Ga e S ->
    heap_correspond Gb e S ->
    〈Ga⁏e ⊢ fsa ∶ (Tta,Ta)〉 ∼(trf_lift_stack Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb⁏e ⊢ fsb ∶ (Ttb,Tb)〉 ->
    Ga⁏e ⊢ t ∶ Tta ->
    Gb⁏e ⊢ t ∶ Ttb ->
    〈Ga ⊢ (t; fsa; S; e; Lva) ∶ Ta〉 ∼(Cond _ _ _)∼∼(trf_lift_conf Cond TL)∼> 〈Gb ⊢ (t; fsb; S; e; Lvb) ∶ Tb〉.

Inductive trf_lift_idtyp_conf (TL: TermTransform): TransformConfig :=

| trf_lift_idtyp_conf_focus G T Ca Cb:

    ty_config_accessories G e fs Sa t T Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories G e fs Sb t T Lvb ->
    heap_correspond_accessories G e Sa ->
    heap_correspond_accessories G e Sb ->
    〈e ⊢ Sa ∶ G〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_heap TL)∼> 〈e ⊢ Sb ∶ G〉 ->

    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ Tt ->

| trf_lift_idtyp_conf_stack G e fsa fsb S t Tt T Lva Lvb:
    ty_config_accessories G e fsa S t T Lva ->
    ty_config_accessories G e fsb S t T Lvb ->

    〈G⁏e ⊢ fsa ∶ (Tt,T)〉 ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_stack TL)∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ fsb ∶ (Tt,T)〉 ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Deref HeapUpdate.

Reserved Notation "t1 ↦ t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Reserved Notation "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2"
         (at level 40, n at level 41, C2 at level 39).

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra DotTactics AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Context Equivalence Indep GeneralTyping.

Require Import Weakening.

Require Import Transformation Subenvironments.

Inductive TrfContextTy :=
  trfctx_ty (G: ctx)(e: renv): TrfContextTy.

Inductive TrfContextObjTy :=
  trfctx_objty (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(e: renv): TrfContextObjTy.

Notation "'〈' G '⁏' e '⊢' a '∶' T '〉'" :=
  (typed_elem (trfctx_ty G e) T a) (at level 41, G at level 32, e at level 32).

Notation "'〈' G '§§' Go '⁏' e '⊢' a '∶' T '〉'" :=
  (typed_elem (trfctx_objty G Go e) T a) (at level 41, G at level 32, Go at level 32, e at level 32).

Definition TermTransform := Transform TrfContextTy typ trm.

Definition LitTransform := Transform TrfContextTy typ lit.

Definition DefTransform := Transform TrfContextObjTy dec def.

Definition DefsTransform := Transform TrfContextObjTy typ defs.

Definition TransformCondOk T A (TEa: TypedElement TrfContextTy T A) :=
  match TEa with
    〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉 => (ctx_ok Ga /\ ok ea)
  end.

Definition TransformCondObjOk T A (TEa: TypedElement TrfContextObjTy T A) :=
  match TEa with
    〈Ga§§Goa⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉 => (ctx_ok (Ga §§& Goa) /\ ok ea)
  end.

Definition TransformIsAnswerTerm (TEa: TypedElement TrfContextTy typ trm) :=
  match TEa with
    〈_ ⊢ t ∶ _〉 => exists vb, t = (trm_var (avar_f vb))
  end.

Definition TransformCondTyping AT (A:Set) (TY: TypingProperty A AT) (TEa: TypedElement TrfContextTy AT A) :=
  match TEa with
    〈G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T〉 => TY G objctx_empty e t T
  end.

Definition TransformCondObjTyping AT (A:Set) (TY: TypingProperty A AT) (TEa: TypedElement TrfContextObjTy AT A) :=
  match TEa with
    〈G§§Go⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T〉 => TY G Go e t T
  end.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Definition TransformCondTermTyped := TransformCondTyping (@obj_typing trm _).

Definition TransformCondLitTyped := TransformCondTyping (@obj_typing lit _).

Definition TransformCondDefTyped := TransformCondObjTyping (@obj_dec_typing def _).

Definition TransformCondDefsTyped := TransformCondObjTyping (@obj_typing defs _).

End WithTypingMode.

Inductive TransformWeakening T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_weaken Ga1 Ga2 Ga3 ea (a: A) Ta:
    ctx_weakens Ga2 ->
    ctx_ok (Ga1 §& Ga2 §& Ga3) ->
    ok ea ->
    TransformWeakening (〈Ga1 §& Ga3⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga1 §& Ga2 §& Ga3⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformObjWeakening T A: Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_weaken Ga1 Ga2 Ga3 Go ea (a: A) Ta:
    ctx_weakens Ga2 ->
    ctx_ok (Ga1 §& Ga2 §& Ga3 §§& Go) ->
    ok ea ->
    TransformObjWeakening (〈Ga1 §& Ga3 §§ Go⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga1 §& Ga2 §& Ga3 §§ Go⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Notation TransformWeakeningCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformWeakening T A)).

Notation TransformObjWeakeningCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjWeakening T A)).

Inductive TransformEWeakening T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_eweaken Ga (e1 e2 e3: renv) (a: A) Ta:
    ctx_ok Ga ->
    ok (e1 & e2 & e3) ->
    TransformEWeakening (〈Ga⁏(e1 & e3) ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga⁏(e1 & e2 & e3) ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformObjEWeakening T A: Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_eweaken Ga Go (e1 e2 e3: renv) (a: A) Ta:
    ctx_ok (Ga §§& Go) ->
    ok (e1 & e2 & e3) ->
    TransformObjEWeakening (〈Ga §§ Go⁏(e1 & e3) ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga §§ Go⁏(e1 & e2 & e3) ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Notation TransformEWeakeningCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformEWeakening T A)).

Notation TransformObjEWeakeningCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjEWeakening T A)).

Inductive TransformWknCtxPush T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_wkn_ctx_push Ga ea (a: A) Ta x vk Tx:
    ctx_ok Ga ->
    x §# Ga ->
    ok ea ->
    TransformWknCtxPush (〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga  § x / vk ~ Tx⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformWknEnvPush T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_wkn_env_push Ga ea (a: A) Ta x xy:
    ctx_ok Ga ->
    ok ea ->
    x # ea ->
    TransformWknEnvPush (〈Ga⁏ea ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga⁏ea & x ~ xy ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Notation TransformWknCtxPushCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformWknCtxPush T A)).

Notation TransformWknEnvPushCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformWknEnvPush T A)).

Inductive TransformSealing T A {TS: Sealable T} {AS: Sealable A} (x: var): Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_seal G e (a: A) Ta:
    TransformSealing x (〈G⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈seal x G⁏e ⊢ seal x a ∶ seal x Ta〉).

Inductive TransformObjSealing T A {TS: Sealable T} {AS: Sealable A} (x: var): Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_seal G Go e (a: A) Ta:
    TransformObjSealing x (〈G§§Go⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈seal x G §§ seal x Go⁏e ⊢ seal x a ∶ seal x Ta〉).

Notation TransformSealingCompat T A trf := (forall x, (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformSealing T A _ _ x))).

Notation TransformObjSealingCompat T A trf := (forall x, (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjSealing T A _ _ x))).

Inductive TransformUnhiding T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_unhide G1 G2 e (a: A) Ta:
    TransformUnhiding (〈((ctx_hide G1) §& G2)⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈(G1 §& G2)⁏e ⊢  a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformObjUnhiding T A: Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_unhide G1 G2 Go e (a: A) Ta:
    TransformObjUnhiding (〈((ctx_hide G1) §& G2)§§Go⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈(G1 §& G2)§§ Go⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Notation TransformUnhidingCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformUnhiding T A )).

Notation TransformObjUnhidingCompat T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjUnhiding T A )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive TransformNarrowing T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_narrow Ga1 x vk (Txa Txb: typ) Ga2 (e: renv) (a: A) Ta:
    ctx_ok (Ga1 § x / vk ~ Txa §& Ga2) ->
    ok e ->
    Ga1⁏e ⊢ Txb <: Txa ->
    TransformNarrowing (〈Ga1 § x / vk ~ Txa §& Ga2⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga1 § x / vk ~ Txb §& Ga2 ⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformObjNarrowing T A: Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_narrow Ga1 x vk Txa Txb Ga2 Go (e: renv) (a: A) Ta:
    ctx_ok (Ga1 § x / vk ~ Txa §& Ga2 §§& Go) ->
    ok e ->
    Ga1⁏e ⊢ Txb <: Txa ->
    TransformObjNarrowing (〈Ga1 § x / vk ~ Txa §& Ga2 §§ Go⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈Ga1 § x / vk ~ Txb §& Ga2 §§ Go ⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformNarrowingSubctx T A: Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_narrow_subctx G1 G2 (e: renv) (a: A) Ta:
    ok e ->
    e ⊢ G2 ⪯ G1 ->
    TransformNarrowingSubctx (〈G1 ⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈G2 ⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

Inductive TransformObjNarrowingSubctx T A: Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_narrow_subctx G1 G2 Go (e: renv) (a: A) Ta:
    ok e ->
    e ⊢ G2 ⪯ G1 ->
    TransformObjNarrowingSubctx (〈G1 §§ Go⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈G2 §§ Go ⁏e ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉).

End WithTypingMode.

Notation TransformNarrowingCompat typing_mode T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformNarrowing typing_mode T A)).

Notation TransformObjNarrowingCompat typing_mode T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjNarrowing typing_mode T A)).

Notation TransformNarrowingSubctxCompat typing_mode T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformNarrowingSubctx typing_mode T A)).

Notation TransformObjNarrowingSubctxCompat typing_mode T A trf := (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjNarrowingSubctx typing_mode T A)).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Context (T A: Set) {AS: SubstVar A} {TS: SubstVar T}.

Inductive TransformSubst  (y: var) (S: typ): Transform TrfContextTy T A :=
  trf_subst G1 x vk G2 e (a: A) (Ta: T):
    ctx_ok (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
    x \notin ctx_fv G1 ->
    renv_notin x e ->
    G1 §& G2 /[§ x -> y] ⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S /[x -> y] ->
    (mode_has_visibility typing_mode ->
      ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) x ->
      ctx_vis (G1 §& G2 /[§ x -> y]) y
    ) ->
    TransformSubst y S (〈(G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2)⁏ (e & x ~ y)  ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈(G1 §& G2 /[§x->y])⁏e ⊢ a/[x->y] ∶ Ta/[x->y]〉).

Inductive TransformObjSubst (y: var) (S: typ): Transform TrfContextObjTy T A :=
  trf_obj_subst G1 x vk G2 Go e (a: A) (Ta: T):
    ctx_ok (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2 §§& Go) ->
    x \notin ctx_fv G1 ->
    renv_notin x e ->
    G1 §& G2 /[§ x -> y] ⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S /[x -> y] ->
    (mode_has_visibility typing_mode ->
      ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2 §§& Go) x ->
      ctx_vis (G1 §& G2 /[§ x -> y] §§& Go /[§§x->y]) y
    ) ->
    TransformObjSubst y S (〈(G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) §§ Go⁏ (e & x ~ y)  ⊢ a ∶ Ta〉) (〈(G1 §& G2 /[§x->y]) §§ Go /[§§x->y]⁏e ⊢ a/[x->y] ∶ Ta/[x->y]〉).

End WithTypingMode.

Notation TransformSubstCompat typing_mode T A trf := (forall (y: var) (S: typ), (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextTy T A ) trf (@TransformSubst typing_mode T A _ _ y S))).

Notation TransformObjSubstCompat typing_mode T A trf := (forall (y: var) (S: typ), (@TransformCondCompat  TrfContextObjTy T A (@TransformCondTypeIdentical TrfContextObjTy T A ) trf (@TransformObjSubst typing_mode T A _ _ y S))).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Init.Datatypes.

Require Import LibExtra DotTactics.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Envs.

Notation simlist := (list var) (only parsing).

Definition simlist_relates (xs1 xs2: simlist) x1 x2 :=
  exists n, LibList.Nth n xs1 x1 /\ LibList.Nth n xs2 x2.

Class Similar (A: Type) := similar: simlist -> simlist -> A -> A -> Prop.

Class SimilarWith (A: Type) := similar_with: simlist -> simlist -> simlist -> simlist -> A -> A -> Prop.

Class SimilarCommon {A: Type} (AS: Similar A) := {

  similar_symm xs ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    similar ys xs b a ;

  similar_trans xs ys zs a b c:
    fresh \{} (length ys) ys ->
    similar xs ys a b ->
    similar ys zs b c ->
    similar xs zs a c ;

  similar_length xs ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    length xs = length ys ;

  similar_reorder xs1 ys1 xs2 ys2 ns a b:
    similar xs1 ys1 a b ->
    list_reorder xs1 ns xs2 ->
    list_reorder ys1 ns ys2 ->
    LibList.noduplicates ns ->
    length ns = length xs1 ->
    similar xs2 ys2 a b ;
}.

Class SimilarOut {A: Set} (AS: Similar A) {AF: FreeVar A} := {

  similar_by_same_eq xs a b:
    similar xs xs a b ->
    a = b ;

  similar_refl_by_fv xs a:
    (fv a) \c (from_list xs) ->
    similar xs xs a a ;

  similar_extend x xs y ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    similar (x::xs) (y::ys) a b ;

  similar_out_fvl xs ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    fv a \c (from_list xs) ;
  similar_out_fvr xs ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    fv b \c (from_list ys) ;

  similar_out_shorten_l x xs y ys a b:
    x \notin fv a ->
    similar (x::xs) (y::ys) a b ->
    similar xs ys a b
}.

Class Envy (E: Type) := {
  envy_ok (e: E): Prop;
  envy_dom (e: E): vars;
  envy_fv (e: E): vars;
  envy_concat(e1 e2: E): E
}.

Class SimilarWithIn (E: Type) (En: Envy E) (AS: SimilarWith E):= {
  similar_with_o_push y1 ys1 y2 ys2 (S1 S2: E) xs1 xs2:
    similar_with ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    similar_with (y1::ys1) (y2::ys2) xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ;
  similar_with_i_append_invl ys1 ys2 (S1 S2: E) xs11 xs12 xs21 xs22:
    length xs11 = length xs21 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (xs11 ++ xs12) (xs21 ++ xs22) S1 S2 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (xs11) (xs21) S1 S2 ;
  similar_with_i_reorder (a1 a2: E) ns (xs1 xs2 ys1 ys2 zs1 zs2: list var):
    list_reorder xs1 ns zs1 ->
    list_reorder xs2 ns zs2 ->
    LibList.noduplicates ns ->
    length xs1 = length ns ->
    length xs2 = length ns ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 a1 a2 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 zs1 zs2 a1 a2 ;
  similar_with_o_reorder (a1 a2: E) ns (ys1 ys2 zs1 zs2: list var):
    list_reorder ys1 ns zs1 ->
    list_reorder ys2 ns zs2 ->
    LibList.noduplicates ns ->
    length ys1 = length ns ->
    length ys2 = length ns ->
    forall (xs1 xs2: list var),
    similar_with ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 a1 a2 ->
    similar_with zs1 zs2 xs1 xs2 a1 a2 ;
  similar_with_i_push_notin ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 x1 x2 S1 S2 :
    similar_with ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    (x1 \notin envy_dom S1) ->
    (x2 \notin envy_dom S2) ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (x1::xs1) (x2::xs2) S1 S2
}.

Class SimilarIn (E: Type) (En: Envy E) (AS: Similar E) := {
  similar_weaken xs ys a1 a2 b1 b2:
    envy_ok (envy_concat a1 a2) ->
    envy_ok (envy_concat b1 b2) ->
    (forall x y, simlist_relates xs ys x y -> (x \in envy_dom a2 <-> y \in envy_dom b2)) ->
    similar xs ys (envy_concat a1 a2) (envy_concat b1 b2) ->
    similar xs ys (a1) (b1) ;
  similar_in_refl_by_fv a xs:
    envy_ok a ->
    (envy_fv a) \c (from_list xs) ->
    similar xs xs a a;
  similar_append_fresh xs1 xs2 (S1 S2: E) zs1 zs2:
    similar xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    fresh (envy_dom S1) (length zs1) zs1 ->
    fresh (envy_dom S2) (length zs2) zs2 ->
    length zs1 = length zs2 ->
    similar (zs1 ++ xs1) (zs2 ++ xs2) (S1) (S2)
}.

Class SimilarEnvIn (A: Set) (AS: Similar (env A)) := {

  similar_by_nil a b:
    similar nil nil a b ;
  similar_extend_notin x xs y ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    x # a ->
    y # b ->
    similar (x::xs) (y::ys) a b ;
  similar_extend_dom x xs y ys a b c d:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    similar (x::xs) (y::ys) (x ~ c) (y ~ d) ->
    binds x c a ->
    binds y d b ->
    similar (x::xs) (y::ys) a b ;
  similar_swap_after xs ys a1 a2 a3 b1 b2 b3:
    ok (a1 & a2 & a3) ->
    ok (b1 & b2 & b3) ->
    similar xs ys (a1 & a2 & a3) (b1 & b2 & b3) ->
    similar xs ys (a1 & a3 & a2) (b1 & b3 & b2) ;
  similar_concat xs ys a1 b1 a2 b2:
    similar xs ys (a1) (b1) ->
    similar xs ys (a2) (b2) ->
    similar xs ys (a1 & a2) (b1 & b2)
}.

Definition similar_by_subst{A: Set}{AS: SubstVar A}{AF: FreeVar A} (xs1 xs2: simlist) (a1 a2: A) :=
  exists a3 xs3,
    (length xs1) = (length xs3) /\
    (length xs2) = (length xs3) /\
    (fresh ((fv a1) \u (fv a2) \u (from_list xs1) \u (from_list xs2)) (length xs3) xs3) /\
    (fv a3) \c (from_list xs3) /\
    a3 /[xs3 --> xs1] = a1 /\
    a3 /[xs3 --> xs2] = a2.

Section SimilarBySubst.

Context  {A: Set}{AS: SubstVar A}{AF: FreeVar A}{AO: Openable A}{AAS: AbstractSyntax AO AF AS}{ASC: SubstCommut AAS}{AFC: FvSubstCases AAS}{ASF: SubstFresh AAS}.

Let SA: Similar A := similar_by_subst.

End SimilarBySubst.

Context  {A: Set}{AS: SubstVar A}{AF: FreeVar A}{AO: Openable A}{AAS: AbstractSyntax AO AF AS}{ASC: SubstCommut AAS}{AFC: FvSubstCases AAS}{ASF: SubstFresh AAS}.

Let SA: Similar A := similar_by_subst.

End SimilarBySubst.

Section SimilarBySubst.

Context  {A: Set}{AS: SubstVar A}{AF: FreeVar A}{AO: Openable A}{AAS: AbstractSyntax AO AF AS}{ASC: SubstCommut AAS}{AFC: FvSubstCases AAS}{ASF: SubstFresh AAS}{ASI: SubstId AAS}.

End SimilarBySubst.

Section SimilarCommon.

Context {A: Set} {AS: Similar A} {AF: FreeVar A} {ASC: SimilarCommon AS}.

End SimilarCommon.

Section SimilarOut.

Context {A: Set} {AS: Similar A} {AF: FreeVar A} {ASC: SimilarCommon AS} {ASO: SimilarOut AS}.

End SimilarOut.

Section SimilarWithIn.

Context {A: Type}{E: Envy A}{SW: SimilarWith A}{SWI: SimilarWithIn E SW}.

End SimilarWithIn.

Inductive similar_env_with{A: Set}(AS: Similar A): SimilarWith (env A)  :=
| similar_env_empty ys1 ys2 S1 S2:
    length ys1 = length ys2 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 nil nil S1 S2
| similar_env_dom ys1 ys2 S1 S2 xs1 xs2 x1 x2 it1 it2:
    @similar_with (env A) (@similar_env_with A AS) ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    (binds x1 it1 S1) ->
    (binds x2 it2 S2) ->
    similar ys1 ys2 it1 it2 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (x1::xs1) (x2::xs2) S1 S2
| similar_env_notin ys1 ys2 S1 S2 xs1 xs2 x1 x2:
    @similar_with (env A) (@similar_env_with A AS) ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    (x1 # S1) ->
    (x2 # S2) ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (x1::xs1) (x2::xs2) S1 S2.

Section SimilarEnvWith.

Context {A: Set}{AS: Similar A}{AF: FreeVar A}{ASC: SimilarCommon AS}{ASO: SimilarOut AS}.

Let SW: SimilarWith (env A) := similar_env_with AS.

#[local] Existing Instance SW.

Definition similar_env x1 x2 a1 a2 := similar_with x1 x2 x1 x2 a1 a2.

End SimilarEnvWith.

Section SimilarEnv.

Context {A: Set}{AS: Similar A}{AF: FreeVar A}{ASC: SimilarCommon AS}{ASO: SimilarOut AS}.

Section SimilarEnvWith.

Let SW: SimilarWith (env A) := similar_env_with AS.

End SimilarEnvWith.

Let SE: Similar (env A) := similar_env.

End SimilarEnv.

    similar_with ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    similar_with (y1::ys1) (y2::ys2) xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ;
  similar_with_i_append_invl ys1 ys2 (S1 S2: E) xs11 xs12 xs21 xs22:
    length xs11 = length xs21 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (xs11 ++ xs12) (xs21 ++ xs22) S1 S2 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (xs11) (xs21) S1 S2 ;
  similar_with_i_reorder (a1 a2: E) ns (xs1 xs2 ys1 ys2 zs1 zs2: list var):
    list_reorder xs1 ns zs1 ->
    list_reorder xs2 ns zs2 ->
    LibList.noduplicates ns ->
    length xs1 = length ns ->
    length xs2 = length ns ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 xs1 xs2 a1 a2 ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 zs1 zs2 a1 a2 ;
  similar_with_o_reorder (a1 a2: E) ns (ys1 ys2 zs1 zs2: list var):
    list_reorder ys1 ns zs1 ->
    list_reorder ys2 ns zs2 ->
    LibList.noduplicates ns ->

    length ys2 = length ns ->
    forall (xs1 xs2: list var),

    similar_with zs1 zs2 xs1 xs2 a1 a2 ;

    (x2 \notin envy_dom S2) ->
    similar_with ys1 ys2 (x1::xs1) (x2::xs2) S1 S2

Class SimilarIn (E: Type) (En: Envy E) (AS: Similar E) := {
  similar_weaken xs ys a1 a2 b1 b2:
    envy_ok (envy_concat a1 a2) ->
    envy_ok (envy_concat b1 b2) ->
    (forall x y, simlist_relates xs ys x y -> (x \in envy_dom a2 <-> y \in envy_dom b2)) ->
    similar xs ys (envy_concat a1 a2) (envy_concat b1 b2) ->
    similar xs ys (a1) (b1) ;
  similar_in_refl_by_fv a xs:
    envy_ok a ->
    (envy_fv a) \c (from_list xs) ->
    similar xs xs a a;
  similar_append_fresh xs1 xs2 (S1 S2: E) zs1 zs2:
    similar xs1 xs2 S1 S2 ->
    fresh (envy_dom S1) (length zs1) zs1 ->
    fresh (envy_dom S2) (length zs2) zs2 ->
    length zs1 = length zs2 ->
    similar (zs1 ++ xs1) (zs2 ++ xs2) (S1) (S2)
}.

Class SimilarEnvIn (A: Set) (AS: Similar (env A)) := {

  similar_by_nil a b:
    similar nil nil a b ;
  similar_extend_notin x xs y ys a b:
    similar xs ys a b ->
    x # a ->
    y # b ->
    similar (x::xs) (y::ys) a b ;

    binds x c a ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext TFree TFreeTyping HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds NothingFresh ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_stack : ctx -> renv -> typ -> stack -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ty_stack_nil : forall G e T U,
      G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
      ty_stack G e T stack_nil U
  | ty_stack_let : forall L G e s t S T U,
      ty_stack G e T s U ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          G § x / v_let ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      ty_stack G e S (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) U.

Inductive heap_closed: heap -> Prop :=
| heap_closed_empty: heap_closed empty
| heap_closed_push S x i:
    heap_closed S ->
    closed i ->
    heap_closed (S & x ~ i)
.

Inductive config_closed: config -> Prop:=
  config_sealed_cfg t s Sigma e Lv:
    closed t ->
    closed s ->
    heap_closed Sigma ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv).

Inductive ty_config : ctx -> config -> typ -> Prop :=
| ty_config_c : forall G e s Sigma Lv t T U,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    ty_stack G e T s U ->
    all_tfree_k_stack G s v_ref ->
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_nothing_fresh_in_config G U (t ; s ; Sigma ; e; Lv) ->
    has_null Lv ->
    sealed G ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    closed U ->
    ty_config G (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) U.

Inductive config_typd : config -> typ -> Prop :=
| config_typd_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_typd c U.

Inductive config_hastyp : config -> Prop :=
| config_hastyp_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_hastyp c.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

Notation config_initial_mk_typ t T null := (t; stack_nil; empty; empty; \{ null } \u fv t \u fv T) (only parsing).

Inductive config_initial: trm -> config -> Prop :=
  config_initial_mk t Lv: config_initial t (t; stack_nil; empty; empty; Lv).

End WithTypingMode.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd _ c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

Arguments ty_config {typing_mode}.

Arguments ty_stack {typing_mode}.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping TypingContext Env.

Class Weakening (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  weaken G1 G2 G3 Go e (ds: A) T:
    (property (G1 §& G3) Go e ds T ->
     ctx_weakens G2 ->
     ctx_ok (G1 §& G2) ->
     property (G1 §& G2 §& G3) Go e ds T).

Section WeakeningLemmata.

Context {A B: Set} {P: TypingProperty A B} {AW: Weakening P}.

Section WeakeningTyLemmata.

Context {A: Set}{AT: Typing A}{AW: Weakening AT}.

End WeakeningTyLemmata.

Section WeakeningSubtyLemmata.

Context {A : Set} {AS : Subtyping} {AW : Weakening AS}.

End WeakeningSubtyLemmata.

Definition WeakeningIndCondition (G: ctx) (property: ctx->Prop) := (
  (property G) ->
  forall G1 G2 G3,
    (G = G1 §& G3 ->
     ctx_weakens G2 ->
     ctx_ok (G1 §& G2) ->
     (property (G1 §& G2 §& G3)))
).

Definition WeakeningInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v : A) T, (WeakeningIndCondition G (fun G => property G Go e v T))).

Definition WeakeningTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := WeakeningInd (obj_typing).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_write x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_call x m y => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_obj T ds => (fv T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  end with
fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (fv v)
  | def_met _ t     => (fv_trm t)
  end with
fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Instance DefsFreeVar : FreeVar defs := fv_defs.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: var) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var x        => trm_var (subst_var z u x)
  | trm_read x1 L     => trm_read (subst_var z u x1) L
  | trm_apply x1 x2    => trm_apply (subst_var z u x1) (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)

  | trm_call x1 L x2  => trm_call (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)

    lit_obj (subst_var z u T)
            (subst_defs z u ds)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i

Key point: typed_red is defined. The guarantee theorem in the paper is likely proven using typed_red and a "guarantee" metatheorem. Still not available.

Let's look at the structure of the target statement again: it uses *untyped* red (`Ca ⊣n↦* Ga2 ⊢ Ca2`? no wait: `ctx_empty ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta ⊣na↦* Ga2 ⊢ Ca2`. Let me parse: `ctx_empty ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta ⊣na↦* Ga2 ⊢ Ca2` — that's the *typed* red closure notation! `F1 ⊢ C1 ∶ T1 ⊣ n ↦* F2 ⊢ C2`. Here F1 = ctx_empty, C1 = Ca, T1 = Ta, F2 = Ga2, C2 = Ca2. So the first disjunct uses typed_red_closure producing a final typing context Ga2 and answer.

And the second disjunct `Ca ⊣n↦* Ca2` uses the *untyped* red closure. Right.

So the conclusion is exactly a "guarantee": either both typed runs terminate with nb <= na and final configs similar under lifted sim; or both can run n untyped steps for all n.

Now, is there a general theorem available as a *Class* field that we could instantiate? `TransformConfigReducesToShortIfTerminates` is a class with a field asserting exactly most of the first disjunct (minus answers and similarity of final configs...). Actually its field:

```
  config_terminates Ca1 ->

  〈Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 ∶ Ta〉 ∼trf2∼> 〈Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 ∶ Tb〉.
```

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import SyntaxClasses SyntaxClassProperties SyntaxClassDepth ListSyntaxClasses SyntaxClassLemmas.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Class Collect `(AS : AbstractSyntax B) `(AS': AbstractSyntax A) :=
  collect : forall {C : Type}, C -> (B -> C) -> (C -> C -> C) -> A -> C.

Arguments collect _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ListLikeCollect `{ASB : AbstractSyntax B} `{ASA: AbstractSyntax A}
      {C: Set} `{ASC: AbstractSyntax C} {TL: ToList C A}
      (CBC: Collect ASB ASC) (CBA: Collect ASB ASA) :=
  collect_fold_right_map : forall (C' : Type) (df : C') f comb (a : A),
    collect df f comb a =
    List.fold_right comb df (List.map (collect df f comb) (to_list a)).

Class CollectCompose `(C: Collect B A) :=
  collect_compose :

Instance TrmSealable : Sealable trm := seal_rec_trm.

Instance LitSealable : Sealable lit := seal_rec_lit.

Instance DefSealable : Sealable def := seal_rec_def.

Instance DefsSealable : Sealable defs := seal_rec_defs.

Instance TrmAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TrmOpenable TrmFreeVar TrmSubstVar := {}.

Instance LitAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax LitOpenable LitFreeVar LitSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefOpenable DefFreeVar DefSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefsOpenable DefsFreeVar DefsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefLabelOf : LabelOf def :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | def_fld m _ => label_fld m
      | def_met m _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a       => (f a)
  | trm_read x m      => (f x)
  | trm_apply f' a      => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t)
  | trm_write x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_call x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)
  | lit_obj T ds => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_defs df f comb ds)
  end with
collect_def {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (d: def) : C :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (collect df f comb T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (f v)
  | def_met _ t     => (collect_trm df f comb t)
  end with
collect_defs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (ds : defs) : C  :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => df
  | defs_cons tl d   => comb (collect_defs df f comb tl) (collect_def df f comb d)
  end.

Instance TrmCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_trm.

Instance LitCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_lit.

Instance DefCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_def.

Instance DefsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_defs.

Fixpoint transform_trm (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (t : trm) (n : nat) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (f a n)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (f v n) m
  | trm_apply f' a    => trm_apply (f f' n) (f a n)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (transform_trm f t1 n) (transform_trm f t2 (S n))
  | trm_lit l t    => trm_lit (transform_lit f l n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  end with
transform_lit (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (l : lit) (n : nat) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (transform f T n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (transform f T (S n))
      (transform_defs f ds (S n))
  end with
transform_def (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (d : def) (n : nat) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (transform f T (S n))
  | def_fld m e => def_fld m (f e n)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (transform_trm f e (S (S n)))
  end with
transform_defs (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (ds : defs) (n : nat) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (transform_defs f tl n) (transform_def f d n)
  end.

Instance TrmTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_trm.

Instance LitTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_lit.

Instance DefTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_def.

Instance DefsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_defs.

  match l with

transform_defs (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (ds : defs) (n : nat) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil

  @transform_lit.

Instance DefTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_def.

Instance DefsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_defs.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import TypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation vis_hide typing_mode G := (
  match (mode_visibility' typing_mode) with
  | mode_visibility_all => G
  | mode_visibility_hide_method => (ctx_hide G)
  end
  ) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(xz: var)(TZ: typ)(xc: var)(TC: typ) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC
  | objctx_lit x T => ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)) xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open x T) (open xc T))
  | objctx_heap y T => ctx_met_refined_heap (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC y T

  end.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

Also the self xz ∶ TZ; if TZ = typ_nocap, self works too.

So the method-body swap is typable. But — the *ctx_hide* wrapping G: `ctx_hide (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)`. ctx_binds traverses ctx_hide (ctx_binds_hide). Fine. The swap rule's `ctx_ok G'` where G' includes ctx_hide: ctx_ok_hide. Fine.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)

  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)

  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)

  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Inductive freshy: vars -> vars -> list var -> list var -> Prop :=
| freshy_nil L Lx:

  x \notin (L \u Lx) ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Defs GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep.

Fixpoint deref_base A (su: SubstVar A) (e: renv) (X: A): A :=
  match e with
  | nil => X
  | cons (w,y) ys => (deref_base su ys (subst_var w y X))
  end.

Class Deref A :=
  deref (e: renv) (a: A): A.

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_avar: Deref avar := deref_base AvarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=
fun e d => match d with
| def_fld l x => def_fld l (deref e x)
| def_met l t => def_met l t
| def_typ l T => def_typ l T
end.

Fixpoint deref_defs_fix(e: renv)(ds: defs) :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)
end.

Instance deref_defs: Deref defs := deref_defs_fix.

Class DerefInFv (A: Set) (AD: Deref A) (AF: FreeVar A):=
  deref_in_fv x e (d: A):
    x \in fv (deref e d) ->
    x \in fv d \/ x \in fv_env e.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra DotTactics AbstractSyntax TypingMode.

Require Import TFree.

Require Import HeapCorrespondence InertContext EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context {typing_mode: Mode}.

Definition ty_config_accessories G e fs S t (T: typ) Lv :=
    inert G /\
    all_tfree_k_stack G fs v_ref /\
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref /\
    ty_nothing_fresh_in_config G T (t ; fs ; S ; e; Lv) /\
    has_null Lv /\
    sealed G /\
    config_closed (t; fs; S; e; Lv) /\
    closed T.

Definition heap_correspond_accessories G (e: renv) (s: heap) :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e.

End WithTypingMode.
====
.

Inductive config_closed: config -> Prop:=
  config_sealed_cfg t s Sigma e Lv:
    closed t ->
    closed s ->
    heap_closed Sigma ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv).

Inductive ty_config : ctx -> config -> typ -> Prop :=
| ty_config_c : forall G e s Sigma Lv t T U,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    ty_stack G e T s U ->
    all_tfree_k_stack G s v_ref ->
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_nothing_fresh_in_config G U (t ; s ; Sigma ; e; Lv) ->
    has_null Lv ->
    sealed G ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    closed U ->
    ty_config G (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) U.

Inductive config_typd : config -> typ -> Prop :=
| config_typd_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_typd c U.

Inductive config_hastyp : config -> Prop :=
| config_hastyp_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_hastyp c.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

Notation config_initial_mk_typ t T null := (t; stack_nil; empty; empty; \{ null } \u fv t \u fv T) (only parsing).

Inductive config_initial: trm -> config -> Prop :=
  config_initial_mk t Lv: config_initial t (t; stack_nil; empty; empty; Lv).

End WithTypingMode.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd _ c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

Arguments ty_config {typing_mode}.

Arguments ty_stack {typing_mode}.

Section WithTypingMode.
