Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons f st)
.

Existing Instance tfree_trm.

Existing Instance tfree_lit.

Existing Instance tfree_def.

Existing Instance tfree_defs.

Existing Instance tfree_stack.

Definition all_tfree_k {A: Set} {AT: TFree A} G (t:A) vk :=
  forall v, tfree v t -> ctx_k G v vk.

Notation all_tfree_k_trm := (@all_tfree_k trm _).

Notation all_tfree_k_def := (@all_tfree_k def _).

Notation all_tfree_k_defs := (@all_tfree_k defs _).

Notation all_tfree_k_stack := (@all_tfree_k stack _).

Definition TFreeInFV (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AF: FreeVar A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    v \in fv t.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInvInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x tR,
      t = (open_rec k x tR) ->
      tfree v tR \/ v = x.

Class TFreeOpenInv(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open_inv v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v (open_rec n x t) ->
    tfree v t \/ v = x
.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x,
    tfree v (open_rec k x t).

Class TFreeOpen(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v t ->
    tfree v (open_rec n x t).

Section TFreeOpenLemmata.

Context (A: Set) {AT: TFree A} {AO: Openable A} {ATO: TFreeOpenInv AT}.

End TFreeOpenLemmata.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_or T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_nocap => df
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)

  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => comb (comb (collect_typ df f comb TC) (collect_typ df f comb TZ)) (collect_typ df f comb TR)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence TFree Deref.

Inductive def_varkinds: ctx -> def -> Prop :=

| def_varkinds_fld G x l:
  ctx_k G x v_loc ->
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l (avar_f x))

| def_varkinds_typ G T l:
  def_varkinds G (def_typ l T)

| def_varkinds_met G t l:
  all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
  def_varkinds G (def_met l t)
.

Inductive defs_varkinds: ctx -> defs -> Prop :=
| defs_varkinds_nil G:
  defs_varkinds G (defs_nil)
| defs_varkinds_cons G ds d:
  defs_varkinds G ds ->
  def_varkinds G d ->
  defs_varkinds G (defs_cons ds d)
.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping.
Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting.
Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.
Require Import ConfigTyping OperationalSemantics TypedOperationalSemantics.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Context (Hms : mode_has_sef typing_mode).

Context (Hmm : mode_has_mutability typing_mode).

(* A variable cannot be typed under the empty context.  This rules out the
   local swap rule firing directly at the top-level empty context. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_empty_nil x T : ctx_binds x T ctx_empty -> False.
Proof.
  intros H. remember ctx_empty as G eqn:E. induction H; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_empty_nil_gen G e (x : var) T :
  G = ctx_empty -> G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T -> False.
Proof.
  intros HG H. induction H; eauto using ctx_binds_empty_nil.
  all: try (subst; eauto using ctx_binds_empty_nil).
  all: eauto 10 using ctx_binds_empty_nil.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_empty_nil (x : var) T : ctx_empty ⁏ empty ⊢ x ∶ T -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_var_empty_nil_gen; eauto. Qed.

(* The base call-swapping rule cannot fire directly over the empty context:
   its receiver-typing premise would require typing a variable under ctx_empty. *)
Lemma swap_at_empty_contra (x1 x2 : var) (m1 m2 : met_label)
      (xp1 xp2 y1 y2 : var) (t : trm) (T1 T2 T TZ1 TZ2 : typ) :
  〈 ctx_empty ⁏ empty
    ⊢ trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x1) m1 (avar_f xp1))
        (trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x2) m2 (avar_f xp2)) t /[<- y2]) /[<- y1]
    ∶ T 〉
  ∼(trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode)∼>
  〈 ctx_empty ⁏ empty
    ⊢ trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x2) m2 (avar_f xp2))
        (trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x1) m1 (avar_f xp1)) t /[<- y1]) /[<- y2]
    ∶ T 〉 -> False.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold transform in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  eapply ty_var_empty_nil; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem swap_calls_transformation_guarantee ta tb Ta Tb:
  〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ta ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm typing_mode (trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode))∼> 〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ tb ∶ Tb〉 ->
  closed ta ->
  closed tb ->
  closed Ta ->
  closed Tb ->

  exists Ca Cb,
    config_initial ta Ca /\
    config_initial tb Cb /\
    (
      ( exists  na nb Ga2 Gb2 Ca2 Cb2,

        nb <= na /\

        ctx_empty ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta ⊣na↦* Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 /\
        ctx_empty ⊢ Cb ∶ Tb ⊣nb↦* Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 /\
        answer Ca2 /\
        answer Cb2 /\

        〈Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_lift_sim_conf typing_mode (trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode))∼> 〈Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 ∶ Tb〉
      ) \/ (
         forall (n : nat),
         exists (Ca2 Cb2 : config),
           Ca ⊣n↦* Ca2 /\
           Cb ⊣n↦* Cb2
      )
    ).

End WithTypingMode.

.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with

      record_type T ->

  〈 ctx_empty ⁏ empty

   local swap rule firing directly at the top-level empty context. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_empty_nil x T : ctx_binds x T ctx_empty -> False.
Proof.

Lemma ty_var_empty_nil_gen G e (x : var) T :
  G = ctx_empty -> G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T -> False.
Proof.
  intros HG H. induction H; eauto using ctx_binds_empty_nil.
  all: try (subst; eauto using ctx_binds_empty_nil).
  all: eauto 10 using ctx_binds_empty_nil.
Qed.

        (trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x2) m2 (avar_f xp2)) t /[<- y2]) /[<- y1]

  inversion H; subst.
  eapply ty_var_empty_nil; eauto.
Qed.

   base case of `trf_iterate` and is what the "identical final configurations"

    ).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping.
Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting.
Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.
Require Import ConfigTyping OperationalSemantics TypedOperationalSemantics.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Context (Hms : mode_has_sef typing_mode).

Context (Hmm : mode_has_mutability typing_mode).

(* A variable cannot be typed under the empty context.  This rules out the
   local swap rule firing directly at the top-level empty context. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_empty_nil x T : ctx_binds x T ctx_empty -> False.
Proof.
  intros H. remember ctx_empty as G eqn:E. induction H; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_empty_nil_gen G e (x : var) T :
  G = ctx_empty -> G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T -> False.
Proof.
  intros HG H. induction H; eauto using ctx_binds_empty_nil.
  all: try (subst; eauto using ctx_binds_empty_nil).
  all: eauto 10 using ctx_binds_empty_nil.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_empty_nil (x : var) T : ctx_empty ⁏ empty ⊢ x ∶ T -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply ty_var_empty_nil_gen; eauto. Qed.

(* The base call-swapping rule cannot fire directly over the empty context:
   its receiver-typing premise would require typing a variable under ctx_empty. *)
Lemma swap_at_empty_contra (x1 x2 : var) (m1 m2 : met_label)
      (xp1 xp2 y1 y2 : var) (t : trm) (T1 T2 T TZ1 TZ2 : typ) :
  〈 ctx_empty ⁏ empty
    ⊢ trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x1) m1 (avar_f xp1))
        (trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x2) m2 (avar_f xp2)) t /[<- y2]) /[<- y1]
    ∶ T 〉
  ∼(trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode)∼>
  〈 ctx_empty ⁏ empty
    ⊢ trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x2) m2 (avar_f xp2))
        (trm_let (trm_call (avar_f x1) m1 (avar_f xp1)) t /[<- y1]) /[<- y2]
    ∶ T 〉 -> False.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold transform in H.
  inversion H; subst.
  eapply ty_var_empty_nil; eauto.
Qed.

(* The lifted similarity is reflexive on any typed configuration.  This is the
   base case of `trf_iterate` and is what the "identical final configurations"
   outcome of the termination branch uses. *)
Lemma trf_lift_sim_conf_refl (TL : TermTransform)
      (TE : TypedElement ctx typ config) :
  TransformCondConfTyped typing_mode TE ->
  TE ∼(trf_lift_sim_conf typing_mode TL)∼> TE.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold trf_lift_sim_conf. eapply trf_iterate_0. exact H.
Qed.

(* The standard initial `Lv = {null} ∪ fv t ∪ fv T` satisfies the two
   freshness-related components of `ty_config`. *)
Lemma initial_nothing_fresh_T (t : trm) (T : typ) (null : var) :
  nothing_fresh_in_config T
    (t ; stack_nil ; empty ; empty ; (\{null} \u fv t \u fv T)).
Proof.
  unfold nothing_fresh_in_config. cbn.
  intros x Hx. repeat rewrite in_union in *. intuition.
Qed.

Lemma initial_has_null (t : trm) (T : typ) (null : var) :
  ex (fun v => v \in (\{null} \u fv t \u fv T)).
Proof.
  apply (ex_intro _ null).
  repeat rewrite in_union. left. apply in_singleton_self.
Qed.

(* Permuting two fresh adjacent context pushes preserves name lookup,
   visibility and well-formedness.  These are the first prerequisites for
   reconciling the two context-extension orders used by the swap rule. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_swap G y1 vk1 T1 y2 vk2 T2 x T :
  y1 <> y2 ->
  ctx_binds x T ((G § y2 / vk2 ~ T2) § y1 / vk1 ~ T1) ->
  ctx_binds x T ((G § y1 / vk1 ~ T1) § y2 / vk2 ~ T2).
Proof.
  intros Hneq H. inversion H as [| v v2 vk t t2 G0 Hne Hb | v t G0 Hb]; subst.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n. exact Hneq. eapply ctx_binds_e.
  - inversion Hb as [| v v2 vk t t2 G0 Hne2 Hb2 | v t G0 Hb2]; subst.
    + eapply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n. exact Hne2. eapply ctx_binds_n. exact Hne. exact Hb2.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_swap G y1 vk1 T1 y2 vk2 T2 x :
  y1 <> y2 ->
  ctx_vis ((G § y2 / vk2 ~ T2) § y1 / vk1 ~ T1) x ->
  ctx_vis ((G § y1 / vk1 ~ T1) § y2 / vk2 ~ T2) x.
Proof.
  intros Hneq H. inversion H as [| v v2 vk t G0 Hne Hv]; subst.
  - eapply ctx_vis_n. exact Hneq. eapply ctx_vis_e.
  - inversion Hv as [| v v2 vk t G0 Hne2 Hv2]; subst.
    + eapply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n. exact Hne2. eapply ctx_vis_n. exact Hne. exact Hv2.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_ok_swap G y1 vk1 T1 y2 vk2 T2 :
  y1 <> y2 ->
  ctx_ok ((G § y2 / vk2 ~ T2) § y1 / vk1 ~ T1) ->
  ctx_ok ((G § y1 / vk1 ~ T1) § y2 / vk2 ~ T2).
Proof.
  intros Hneq Hok.
  inversion Hok as [| G0 v vk t Hok0 Hv | |]; subst.
  inversion Hok0 as [| G0 v vk t HokG Hv2 | |]; subst.
  apply notin_union_r in Hv. destruct Hv as [Hv_a Hv_b].
  assert (Hy1 : y1 §# G) by exact Hv_b.
  assert (Hy2 : y2 §# (G § y1 / vk1 ~ T1)).
  { apply notin_union_l.
    - apply notin_singleton_l. intros Heq. apply Hneq. symmetry. exact Heq.
    - exact Hv2. }
  eapply ctx_ok_push.
  - eapply ctx_ok_push. exact HokG. exact Hy1.
  - exact Hy2.
Qed.
